text:
nina: quick alert 1: small spike in 504s from dedicated eu-central1 pool since 00:42 UTC. suspect recent prefix-cache alloc bump in v3.2.1 -> planning a micro-revert. proposing registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-patch.2 and expedited canary.
omar: paste a tiny log snippet + rollback steps pls. Also pickup canary plan.
nina: logs:
```
2026-04-15T00:43:05Z inference-21 error: prefix_cache_alloc exceeded cap -> reclaim -> request timeout 504
2026-04-15T00:43:06Z inference-22 warn: upstream closed while streaming
```
rollback: pin to v3.2.0, cordon+drain new pods, redeploy previous image. runbook ref RB-780.
omar: propose 2 canary pods in eu-central1, 10m watch, 40% ramp for 8m, then full if green. disable HPA on canary and set mem limit back to 7Gi. I can approve.
rachel: added quick smoke PR and small healthcheck script. CI smoke passed.
deploybot: Deploy requested by nina -> eu-central1 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-patch.2. Observing 10m.
(deploybot) 00:55 UTC: canary 2/2 ready. healthchecks OK; 5xx trending down.
oncall-bot: @nina assigned: oncall until 2026-04-15T04:00Z. Alerts enabled: 5xx-rate, p99-latency, node-memory.
omar: +1 SRE. authorize ramp to 40%. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Ramping eu-central1 -> 40% traffic for 8m.
01:04 UTC - deploybot: 8m observation complete. 5xx down ~89%, latency stable, no new OOM traces.
nina: proceeding to full rollout with a 10m final watch. changelog snippet queued.changelog-bot: Reminder: add internal changelog entry before closing thread.
deploybot: Full rollout complete for eu-central1. Tag: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-patch.2. No alerts during watches.
rachel: published changelog entry and short internal note: "v3.2.1-patch.2: revert prefix-cache allocation bump causing intermittent 504s in EU-CENTRAL. No API changes."
omar: creating follow-up RB-780 to improve CI integration for cache allocation changes. Marking resolved once postmortem ticket created.
nina: postmortem ticket RB-780 created. resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
